config.selection: Allten trainedcell BA loss <=2pp vs paired parent; then best minmotionBA, meanmotionAUC, earlier; include parentfallback
config.stream_matching: Exact parent family-local stream state; shared per-family evidence prefixes, not necessarily same per-delay assignment

selected_assessment.interpretation: All ten cells BA screen at -2pp; then minimum motion BA and mean motion AUC; ties earlier. Screen is not equivalence proof.
